name: Bordeaux
hook: Left Bank vs Right Bank, mapped from INAO parcel data: the Médoc communes, Saint-Émilion and Pomerol, Graves, Entre-Deux-Mers, and the sweet wines of Sauternes.

name: Burgundy
hook: Village, Premier Cru, and Grand Cru appellations of Chablis and the Côte d'Or, covering the Côte de Nuits and Côte de Beaune.

name: Champagne
hook: The Champagne AOC and its main subregions: Montagne de Reims, Vallée de la Marne, Côte des Blancs, and the Côte des Bar in the Aube.

name: Alsace
hook: Alsace, Alsace Grand Cru, and Crémant d'Alsace AOCs along the Vosges foothills.
